Vision Government Solutions

|

CANTERBURY,CT

|

Welcome

Welcome to the Assessor’s database for the Town
of Canterbury, CT. Data is as of 10/01/2025.

Sales transactions reflected through October 1st, 2025.

The information provided in this database reflects the updated value for each individual property INCLUDING those approved for PA 490 Farm, Forest and Open Space status but NOT INCLUDING any other exemptions or tax reduction programs for which the owner may be eligible.

The Mill Rate for the 2024 Grand List is 16.76. The mill rate for the tax year starting on October 1, 2025 will be finalized in 2026 after a budget is approved. A partial rate bill on Real Estate was mailed in August using the 2024 rate. Once the mill rate is set, additional bills on Real Estate and the Motor Vehicle and Personal Property bills will be mailed.

Should you wish to submit an updated picture of your home for this site, please email it to the Assessor for upload.

Phone:
860-546-6035 Email: assessor@canterburyct.org [mailto:assessor@canterburyct.org]

The "Vision Tax Map" available under the "map it" button may not be up to date. For the most recent map information, please go to Northeastern Connecticut Council of Governments - NECCOG [https://neccog.org/programs_and_services/gis.php] Northeastern Connecticut Council of Governments - NECCOG [https://neccog.org/programs_and_services/gis.php] to use their GIS viewer.

Please be advised that online maps are created using historical information, may not accurately reflect the correct data as of the date of your inquiry and, as such, CANNOT be used for legal purposes . Should you need up-to-date map data, please look for a Survey Map number on the parcel data screen and contact the Town Clerk for a copy of the most recent survey.
